correctness.rationale: Weighted local orbifold charts give four A2 quotient points and show the weight-two point lifts smoothly. The individual sign involution fixed curves are double covers of anticanonical genus-one curves branched at six points, so have genus four; the product fixes six intersection points and two weight-two lifts. Topological Lefschetz yields character dimensions 3,4,4,11. The two regular modules of eight exceptional divisors yield Picard lower bound 13. The marked 12-dimensional branch-pair family modulo 5-dimensional weighted automorphisms is generically finite in polarized K3 moduli (finite polarized automorphism group), forcing a 7-dimensional period image and very-general Picard upper bound 13. The extracted standalone checker passed the stated finite computations.
